title: Random Effects Every Minute
description: This project turns normal minecraft into a chaotic playthrough with random effects.
body: A Fabric Minecraft mod that gives every player a random status effect every 60 seconds, creating unpredictable and chaotic gameplay. Every minute, all players on the server receive a randomly selected status effect ranging from powerful buffs to dangerous debuffs. You need to add [this library](https://modrinth.com/mod/ui-timer-lib) to your mods folder as well for this mod to work. Here is an example image of the mod ### Installation - Install Fabric Loader and Fabric API - Download the mod - Download [this library](https://modrinth.com/mod/ui-timer-lib) - Place these mods into your mods folder - Launch Minecraft ### How It Works Every 60 seconds the mod: - Waits for the timer to reach 60 seconds - Selects a random status effect - Applies it to all online players - Resets and repeats forever ### Effects Included Automatically initiated, the mod selects from a pool of vanilla Minecraft effects, including: - Speed - Strength - Haste - Regeneration - Jump Boost - Resistance - Slowness - Weakness - Poison - Blindness - Levitation
